query: The company reported quarterly earnings that beat analyst expectations, with revenue up 15% year over year driven by strong cloud services growth. However, the stock dropped 3% in after-hours trading as management gave cautious guidance for next quarter, citing macroeconomic headwinds and slowing enterprise spending in key markets.

Scientists have discovered a new species of deep-sea fish near hydrothermal vents in the Pacific Ocean. The fish, which has translucent skin and no eyes, appears to have adapted to survive in complete darkness and extreme pressure. Researchers believe studying its biology could offer insights into extremophile life.

The city council voted 6-3 last night to approve a new zoning ordinance that will allow mixed-use development in previously residential-only neighborhoods. Supporters say it will ease the housing shortage, while opponents worry about increased traffic and strain on local schools and infrastructure.

A major software vulnerability was discovered affecting millions of devices worldwide. Security researchers say the flaw could allow attackers to remotely execute code on affected systems. Patches are being rolled out, but experts warn that unpatched devices remain at significant risk for weeks or months.

The marathon runner completed the course in just under two hours and ten minutes, missing the world record by less than a minute. She said afterward that weather conditions and a strong headwind in the final miles likely cost her the record, but she remains optimistic about future attempts.

Farmers in the region are struggling with an unusually dry growing season, with rainfall down nearly 40% compared to historical averages. Crop yields are expected to be significantly lower this year, and agricultural economists warn this could push food prices higher in the coming months.

The museum unveiled a newly restored painting that had been hidden under layers of overpaint for decades. Conservators used infrared imaging and careful chemical analysis to reveal the original composition, which experts say may change how historians understand the artist's early career.

A new study published this week found that people who get consistent sleep schedules, even on weekends, report significantly better cognitive performance and mood than those with irregular sleep patterns. Researchers tracked over 3,000 participants for a year to reach these conclusions.

The airline announced it will cut several regional routes starting next month, citing rising fuel costs and lower-than-expected demand on those routes. Affected passengers will be rebooked on alternative flights, though some smaller communities will lose direct air service entirely.

Engineers unveiled a prototype battery that can charge to 80% capacity in under ten minutes while using significantly less rare earth material than current designs. If it can be manufactured at scale, the technology could substantially reduce the cost and environmental impact of electric vehicles.
